facts.statement: A limited-time Members Double Discount raised the discount on Station Cash Market purchases for members from 10% to 20%.
facts.quote: sur tous les objets achetés du marché Station Cash de 10% à 20%

facts.statement: The Members Double Discount event ran from 1 September at 20:59 CET until 8 September at 20:59 CET (Paris time). The year is not stated in the post.
facts.quote: valable à partir du 1er Septembre à 20h59 CET jusqu'au 8 Septembre 20h59 CET

article_summaries.title: Double Remise aux Membres Pour un Temps Limité!
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post announcing a time-limited Members double discount on Market purchases in Free Realms. Members get a 20% discount on Market items, and for a limited window the Station Cash Market discount rises from 10% to 20%. The page gives no year, so the event dates are only partly fixed (September 1 to September 8, times in CET/Paris).
